newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Acindar starts as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acindar starts as hold.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said it had started coverage of Argentine steelmaker Acindar with a rating of hold.

-- The firm said in a Jan 15 report it assigned the rating "primarily due to the company's significant price appreciation following the Siderar initial public offering, weak cash flow and high leverage."

-- It added that since May 1995, "Acindar's price has jumped 122.7 percent versus 22.7 percent for the Merval and 37.1 percent for Siderar. We are also forecasting only a moderate recovery in the construction sector in fiscal 1997 with a stronger outlook for fiscal 1998."
-- Acindar's shares rose 0.030 to 1.540 in Buenos Aires.
